concerns.text: The plan proposes downloading the 'organic subset' of the Crystallography Open Database (COD) via direct HTTP fetch from 'http://www.crystallography.net/cod/' and filtering for < 500MB. The COD is a massive repository (>1.5M entries, >10GB uncompressed). A direct download of the 'organic subset' without a pre-filtered mirror or specific accession ID is not a feasible, deterministic data resource for a 6-hour GitHub Actions free-tier job. The plan lacks a specific, verified, pre-filtered dataset source (e.,g., a specific HuggingFace dataset ID or a pre-packaged tarball of the organic subset) that guarantees the < 500MB constraint and the presence of lattice parameters. Relying on a raw download + local filtering risks exceeding the 6-hour runtime and 7GB RAM limit before the pipeline even begins.
